**University Brings**: unsupervised anomaly detection methods, an ICS testbed with a labelled dataset, and one-class classification proven on Modbus.

**Why This Pair**: the company holds real traffic but lacks a method, while the researcher has the method but no real OT deployment data, with a specific gap around BACnet coverage.
